about: The models a PAN on someone's own computer runs. PAN Setup reads this to know what to download; PAN reads it to point its settings at what arrived (src/model-set.js). Everything comes straight from the publisher to the person's computer: Ollama's library, or Hugging Face for PAN's own two. Nothing is hosted by PAN and none of it needs an account.

sets.light: a computer with less than 24 GB of memory: one stock model does the sorting too

models.name: syrinx-lfm-r15:latest
models.what: Talks to you. PAN's own tuned model, small enough to answer in a fifth of a second with no graphics card.

models.name: pan-phi-r1:latest
models.what: Answers real questions: facts, how things work, search results.
models.licence: MIT (Microsoft Phi-4 mini, tuned by PAN)

models.name: gemma4:e2b
models.what: Background jobs, and the backup when the talking model hands a turn back.

models.name: gemma4:e4b
models.what: Sorts requests and runs the safety checks.

models.name: moondream:latest
models.what: Says what is in a photo the phone could not read.
